note: Prices go stale. Providers change them without notice, and OpenRouter's listing for a model called directly at its vendor is the vendor's list price, not necessarily the rate on a particular account. Re-run scripts/update_model_prices.py before quoting a cost. cache_write (USD per million tokens WRITTEN into the prompt cache) was added on 2026-08-09 from OpenRouter's input_cache_write field; every other rate in this file is untouched from the 2026-08-07 fetch, so the campaign's cost basis is unchanged. 0.0 means the provider publishes no cache-write premium, which the harness bills at the base input rate.
